title: Advance party departs for WESTPAC

paragraphs.text: The RLT-5 advance party departed the continental United States by air for the Western Pacific on January 6.
BLT 2/5’s members were Maj R. A. Pape, battalion S-3; 1stLt W. E. Smith, motor transport officer; SSgt J. D. WYZSMIRSKI, property NCO; and Cpl H. K. NOE, S-1 clerk.
